card.name: Travel and departure in narratives
card.fires_on: Words in story or travel text about someone leaving or being carried somewhere, such as drove away, set sail, boarding a train, or a vehicle carrying someone. It fires on the verb, particle or vehicle word that completes the motion.

modes.label: Departing by vehicle
modes.description: The word completing a departure or boarding, like away, sail, boat or for.
modes.example: She just got in her car and drove<< away>>."

modes.label: Being carried along
modes.description: Words in a scene where a character or object is carried or lifted to another place.
modes.example: Now the child sat upon the back of the Katcina and the latter<< took>> it along.
